metadata.title: U torsion structure in Heegaard Floer homology
metadata.abstract: We construct infinite families of Brieskorn spheres with three singular fibers for which the difference between the largest and the second largest length of U-torsion in their Heegaard Floer homology $HF^-$ increases to infinity as the family parameter increases. In particular, these families give a negative answer to the strong geography restriction on rational homology spheres. As an application, these families give the examples of integer homology spheres that are neither surgery on a knot nor large surgery on links.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 构造三奇异纤维 Brieskorn 球的无限族，使 HF⁻ 中最长与次长 U-扭结长度之差无界，由此否定有理同调球的强 geography 限制。
analysis.breakthrough: 将扭结长度分布转化为不能由某类结或链环手术得到的整数同调球例子。
analysis.limitations: 应用中 surgery 和 large surgery 的准确类别需查原定理，不宜泛称完全不能由任何手术表示。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 6 Astra 和 Pro 协助识别定理1.5的部分例族、验证其有效性，并参与写作与证明检查；作者随后复核计算并修订表述。没有笼统将整篇核心框架归于模型。

analysis.priorityReason: Floer 同调实现问题和手术识别的具体新障碍。
